decision: Recover the process-invalid wave-56 decision after repairing its snapshot mismatch. The prior three jobs produced no scientific evidence: both expert replications referenced a recipe absent from their exact snapshot, and the planning audit could not instantiate the wave-55 positive-anchor checkpoint. Retry the same bounded comparison from one compatible snapshot. Accept expert positive-anchor as a stable candidate-privileged training recipe only if seeds 1 and 2 both finish with finite losses, effective rank at least 50, token-aligned shuffled-action error ratio above 1, and later show positive deployment-feasible current-buffer horizon-2 planning improvement. The replay checkpoint audit is independently informative at the already-fixed horizon-2 protocol. Oracle-selected training anchors remain candidate/terminal-privileged and are not deployment evidence.
